title: Fox and Hound
brief: Drag the fox across two snowfields to its den while hounds chase it; lure them behind boulders, which block them. In the second field a hunter walks the middle line, so time your crossing; any catch ends the run.

title: Shadow Twin
brief: Collect five mirror shards while your own shadow hunts you, a little faster after every shard; after the third a second reflection steps out of the corner. Mirror pillars block them; a touch ends the run.

title: Honey Raid
brief: Steal four honeycombs as a bear. Every theft sends the bees after you; splash into the pond to send them home, and use the trees as cover. Three stings and you lose; the fourth comb wins.

title: Museum Heist
brief: Slip past the lobby guard to grab the keycard, cross a gallery of alternating laser beams and a circling guard, and lift the gem from the guarded vault; then the getaway van arrives. Guards catch you at once, each laser trips the alarm (three alarms and it is lockdown) and wakes the guard dog.

title: Hedge Maze Lanterns
brief: Steer a wanderer with the joystick through a haunted hedge garden four screens big and light five lanterns; the last one waits behind a gate whose key is hidden in the maze. Ghosts chase you, but every lantern lures them to a drifting wisp for a few seconds; three touches and your light is gone.

title: Ant Tunnel Escort
brief: Drag a worker ant up through three soil layers while three larvae follow it in a line, and bring all of them into the queen's chamber. Spiders sweep two tunnels (touching the worker or any larva loses) and a slow beetle stalks the last larva in the line.

title: Lab Rat Trials
brief: Steer a lab rat cell by cell with the d-pad through three grid mazes: fetch the keys that open the doors to the cheese while handlers patrol the corridors. In the last trial the lab cat glides after you; catnip sends it after a wind-up mouse for a few seconds. Any catch ends the run.

title: Minotaur Labyrinth
brief: Step through a labyrinth with the d-pad while the minotaur glides after you, blocked only by the walls; time your way past blades that slide out of the walls. Find the sword, then touch the beast to slay it and open the gate to the exit; torches slow it down for a while. Touching it unarmed or meeting a blade ends the run.

title: Harbour Lights
brief: Steer a smuggler's skiff with the joystick through a harbour that scrolls sideways, weaving between staggered piers and patrol boats, and pick up three crates so the boom at the harbour mouth lifts. Searchlights sweep the water; get caught in one and a coastguard cutter comes after you. Any boat that touches you ends the run.

title: Orchard Tag
brief: You are it: chase down and tag four kids who run their own loops around a fenced orchard, pausing at each corner, before the 45-second clock runs out. Every tag makes the rest run faster, apple trees block your way, and the farmer's goose hunts you, each peck costing five seconds.

title: Bodyguard
brief: Walk a VIP, who follows a step behind you, up a zig-zag street to the limo. Attackers stream out of alleys and go for the VIP; your agent is solid, so body-block them, and step into a sniper's laser dot to take the aim. Three hits on the VIP and you lose; a first-aid kit gives one back.

title: Power Cut
brief: Sneak across two office floors to the exit. The power cuts out for two seconds in every five, and security camera cones only see you while the lights are on, so move in the dark; guards on patrol see you either way. Each camera sighting costs one of three lives and sends you back to the start; a keycard opens the door on each floor.

title: Getaway City
brief: Drive a getaway car with the joystick around a city grid three screens wide, pick up three bags of cash to open the hideout's garage, and park inside. Police cars pour in from the corners in faster waves and chase you, and spike strips slide across two streets; a police scanner sends every cop after a look-alike decoy for five seconds. Three hits and you are busted.

title: Dead Drops
brief: A spy crosses a night-time park to collect three dead drops in order; each one only appears once the one before is picked up. Park guards patrol and hurry when you crunch over gravel, picking up the second drop launches a drone that hunts you, and the last drop sits in a rose garden whose key is in the shed. With all three in, the extraction helicopter lands; any catch ends the mission.

title: Trench Dive
brief: Pilot a small sub with the joystick down a deep trench, zig-zagging between rock shelves to reach the wreck at the bottom before your air runs out; air pockets top up the tank. Drifting mines cost a life, and an eel stalks you from a distance, spitting homing jellyfish; three hits and the sub is crushed.
